kind: Constructed whole-object mechanism comparison; no empirical observations
reference_measure: Log-orthopolic in physical object mass: three bins centered on 1, 2, 4, each with width ln(2)
initialization: Independent draws from the analytic baseline stationary distribution of each mechanism, then switch to the case rates at time zero
mass_action_convention: Forward a1*n1*(n1-1) and a2*n2*(n2-1); breakup b1*n2 and b2*n4, with no combinatorial division by two
interpretation: Exact stationary predictions and finite-time simulation checks of specified models; no empirical confirmation or simulation-fitted parameters
